#!/bin/bash
# Edge-case and error-behaviour suite for planb64.
B=/work/submit/planb64
T=/work/tests/edge
rm -rf $T && mkdir -p $T && cd $T
pass=0; fail=0
ok()   { pass=$((pass+1)); }
bad()  { fail=$((fail+1)); echo "FAIL: $1"; }

# expect_build <fib-content> <expected-image> [name]
expect_build() {
  printf '%b' "$2" > fib.txt
  rm -f out.idx
  $B build fib.txt out.idx >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || [ -s o.txt ] || [ -s e.txt ]; then bad "$1: build rc=$rc out=$(cat o.txt) err=$(cat e.txt)"; return; fi
  printf '%b' "$3" > exp.idx
  if ! cmp -s out.idx exp.idx; then bad "$1: image mismatch"; diff out.idx exp.idx | head -6; return; fi
  ok
}
expect_err_build() {
  printf '%b' "$2" > fib.txt
  rm -f out.idx
  $B build fib.txt out.idx >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then bad "$1: rc=$rc (want 2)"; return; fi
  if [ -s o.txt ]; then bad "$1: stdout not empty"; return; fi
  if ! head -c6 e.txt | grep -q '^ERROR:'; then bad "$1: stderr=$(cat e.txt)"; return; fi
  if [ -e out.idx ]; then bad "$1: destination created"; return; fi
  ok
}
# expect_lookup <image> <trace-content> <expected-stdout> <mode...> <name>
expect_lookup() {
  img=$1; printf '%b' "$2" > tr.txt; printf '%b' "$3" > exp.txt; shift 3; name=$1; shift
  for m in "$@"; do
    $B lookup "$img" tr.txt $m >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
    if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || [ -s e.txt ]; then bad "$name [$m]: rc=$rc err=$(cat e.txt)"; return; fi
    if ! cmp -s o.txt exp.txt; then bad "$name [$m]: output mismatch"; diff o.txt exp.txt|head -6; return; fi
  done
  ok
}
expect_err_lookup() {
  img=$1; printf '%b' "$2" > tr.txt; name=$3; shift 3
  $B lookup "$img" tr.txt "$@" >o.txt 2>e.txt; rc=$?
  if [ $rc -ne 2 ]; then bad "$name: rc=$rc (want 2)"; return; fi
  if [ -s o.txt ]; then bad "$name: stdout not empty"; return; fi
  if ! head -c6 e.txt | grep -q '^ERROR:'; then bad "$name: stderr=$(cat e.txt)"; return; fi
  ok
}
